legs.selection: Atletico San Luis scores >=1 vs Pachuca

P1.learning: Puebla failed to score again, prospectively confirming the LOW_ATTACK warning in the first restored-blindness jornada. America-Mazatlan U3.5 also failed badly in a 5-0, showing that broad under markets can be vulnerable when a strong favorite has blowout potential.

P2.learning: Three moderate-to-high probability goal-based legs all hit. The selector can find useful price disagreement, but one winning ticket is not enough to validate MARKET_PROXY_V1 as true edge.

P3.learning: The only negative-proxy-EV ticket won 3/3. This reinforces that one-jornada realized outcome must not be confused with ex-ante decision quality; retain the EV counterfactual rather than rewriting the selector.
